description: Break down detections by source code (0=DPVM pipeline, 1=FRPV reference, 2=OSM, 3=manual correction, 4=recall sample), for one département or all of France, with human-readable labels. A detection can carry several sources, so per-source counts overlap and do not add up to the total. Also returns how many detections are identified by 2+ sources (the meaning of quality_filter). Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.

dpt.description: French département code, e.g. "33". Omit for all of France.
